Pulse 0.14.1

What's fixed:
- Quotes now keep the fraction digits each market actually needs. Stocks and precious metals can show a third decimal when the print carries one (for example HK penny stocks or silver), Japan and Korea drop trailing `.00` on whole-yen/won prices, and crypto still pads large coins to two places while preserving finer pairs.
- In the pinned floating window, the pin control in the title bar is a plain toolbar button again. It no longer stays lit with Liquid Glass selected chrome, which made the top-right corner feel heavier than the neighboring search and share actions.

For first-time installation, download Pulse-0.14.1.dmg and drag Pulse to Applications. The zip asset is used by Sparkle automatic updates.
